podcast.title: Documentary and Suicide
podcast.body: Borsheim was the subject of a documentary titled "Dead Hands Dig Deep." Before taking his own life in 2017, he had threatened and planned to kill the entire film crew of that documentary. "He's even got his own documentary entitled Dead Hands Dig Deep."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Self-Mutilation and Necrophilia on Stage
podcast.body: Edwin Borsheim, also known as Kettle Cadaver, had a history of extreme and disturbing live performances. His acts included stabbing himself, severing one of his nipples on stage, and engaging in unspeakable acts with dead animals in front of an audience. "His resume includes stabbing himself, severing one of his nipples off on stage and unspeakable acts with dead animals in front of an audience."
